# Locate the row in Volume containing the usable headers:

        header_row = r

if header_row is None:

origin_col = vol_headers.get("origin port", 1)
equip_col = vol_headers.get("equipment type", 2)

    header = norm(ws_vol.cell(header_row, c).value)

# Build lookup: (origin portcode, equipment type, destination portcode) -> volume
